name: llmwiki-media-ingest
description: Route web, video, Douyin, WeChat Channels share links, transcripts, and local media into an LLMwiki workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Route web, video, Douyin, and WeChat Channels sources into LLMwiki.
interface.longDescription: Adds source routing plus user-authorized WeChat Channels share-link collection through a local desktop WeChat downloader, then hands artifacts to the existing LLMwiki workflow.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route this source into my LLMwiki workflow.
